source_preconditions: Grid v2 existing managed loopback source and startup identity
original 1m closed source records validated via Grid qualify_records
exact single producer identity/source revision/epoch and same symbol
all source minutes contiguous and unique, all 5m or 15m buckets fully covered
all source event end clocks <= cutoff; no cross future bar, no partial current bar
source 1m may be PARTIAL only, never GAP/STALE/UNAVAILABLE for data output
numeric_policy: Math canonical pure OHLCV/volume/turnover rules; no duplicate numeric kernels in Root
output_policy: derived observation only, exchange_completeness NOT_ATTESTED, quality and source_authenticity NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_ATTESTED, paper_admitted false and execution_authority false
handoff: B/D must publish an exact schema/DTO implementation, status and source review before this contract can be treated as matched
